items.title: DeVonta Smith: Could miss multiple games
items.body_text: Smith (hamstring), who has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams, is viewed "at very best, questionable" for the Eagles' Week 5 game versus the Jaguars in London, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Baker Mayfield: Could miss up to six weeks
items.body_text: Mayfield's dislocated right thumb could keep him out anywhere from 3-to-6 weeks, depending on how quickly he's able to resume gripping the football without issue, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Terry McLaurin: Sitting out London game
items.body_text: McLaurin (hamstring) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Colts in London. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Puka Nacua: No limitations expected in return
items.body_text: Nacua (hip) isn't expected to have limitations on his workload during Sunday's game in Philadelphia, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sam LaPorta: Breaks off contract negotiations
items.body_text: LaPorta and the Lions have broken off contract talks after several weeks of discussions, and the tight end now is set to be an unrestricted free agent in 2027, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
